sessions.prompt_text: Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown. Use exactly these keys: request_id, review_role, verdict, recommend_to_developer, p0_separate_from_p1, deadline_requirement_not_overclaimed, platform_limitations_explicit, raw_address_minimized, continuity_testable, original_hostname_tls_preserved, retry_fallback_reresolution_closed, provider_support_created, formal_security_review_completed, implementation_authorized, authority_claimed, blocking_findings, required_changes, reason. Set request_id to PRE65-QF-INTEGRATION-01 and review_role to INTEGRATION_MAINTAINER_CANDIDATE. verdict must be READY_FOR_NEXT_RECOMMENDATION, REVISE, or BLOCKED. recommend_to_developer must be YES, CONDITIONAL, or NO. Review this public-safe Development contract as an integration maintainer: P0 performs exactly one getaddrinfo call with AF_UNSPEC, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP, flags 0, exact allowlisted hostname and port 443. It requires a 5000 ms deadline but explicitly states that getaddrinfo has no per-call timeout parameter and the enforcement mechanism is not selected. It caps raw and unique usable results at 64, deduplicates full tuples, selects FIRST_UNIQUE_IN_RESOLVER_ORDER_V1, and admits that resolver order may differ by platform. It selects one address only. P0 returns a sanitized observation with no hostname, IP, sockaddr, canonname, DNS packet, credential, body, or exception string. A non-serialized one-request ResolvedEndpoint carries the original hostname, selected address, protocol fields, and an opaque random handle to P1. P1 must consume the same object, cannot call a resolver or socket.create_connection, and may create one socket and attempt one connect. P2 TLS uses the original allowlisted hostname. Retry, fallback, redirect, re-resolution, second address, and synthetic P0 PASS are forbidden. The design has 6 positive and 24 negative offline cases; no tests or implementation exist. Assess each boolean honestly. Set provider_support_created, formal_security_review_completed, implementation_authorized, and authority_claimed to false. blocking_findings and required_changes must each contain one to eight concise strings. reason must be concise. READY_FOR_NEXT_RECOMMENDATION does not authorize implementation.
